desc:
🎮PC, Mobile, Console & VR supported
👍Please like, it helps alot!!!
👥User instruments & multiplayer with 8 people!
🎶Create songs & have silly dummies dance to them!

Incredible Blox is a sandbox that features various mods. You drag and drop instruments that, when combined, create a mix.
It includes various bonus things such as Multiplayer, 4 instrument rows & many more to spice up the experience!

Features Kats, Mustard Colorbox, Sprunked, 1996, Deadline, Orin Ayo, Yubin Niiku 2, Next & many more!

Credits in-game

All ingame instruments are the property of their original composers. Please discuss with the original composers before using them in your content!

If you are the creator of a mod featured in this game and want to discuss about the inclusion of it please contact blocco
